text: ユウと　いっしょなら　しょうぶ　しても　いいけど…　２たい２で　やろうよ

structure.jp: ユウと　いっしょなら
しょうぶ　しても　いいけど…

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: しょうぶ　しても　いい
patterns.explanation: てもいい after a verb says doing it is fine with the speaker. しょうぶ　しても　いい = 'I don't mind battling'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら sets a condition: 'if that is the case'. いっしょなら = 'if it's together'.

patterns.name: 〜よう (let's)
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to the おう sound is the casual way to say 'let's'. やろう = 'let's do it'.
